baseCommissionNote: All base prices include a simple background (solid color, gradient, or basic pattern).

specialtyCommissions.label: Sticker / Emote Pack (5)
specialtyCommissions.notes: Sticker and emote packs are created from available YCH templates. Fully custom stickers may require an additional quote.

process.title: Submit Request
details: Provide character references, commission type, a project description, and additional notes.

process.title: Consultation
details: I will review your request, discuss details, answer questions, and confirm availability.

process.title: Private Client Portal
details: A private Discord channel will be created for your project.
Your channel is used for project communication, reference storage, progress updates, work-in-progress reviews, revision requests, and final file delivery.

process.title: Sketch Approval
details: Minor revisions and adjustments may be requested at this stage.

process.title: Line Art Approval
details: Major changes will not be accepted after approval.

process.title: Color Approval
details: Review flat colors before rendering or shading begins.

process.title: Final Delivery
details: Final polish and minor corrections are completed.
Files are delivered after final approval and payment.

schedule: 50% payment is required before work begins.
Remaining balance is due after line art approval.
Final files will not be delivered until payment has been completed.
refund: If I cancel your commission for any reason other than a violation of my Terms of Service, your payment will be refunded in full.
Once rendering or painting has begun, the commission becomes non-refundable.
paymentPolicy.note: Alternative payment arrangements may be discussed on a case-by-case basis.

ychPolicy: YCH (Your Character Here) commissions are offered at a reduced price because the pose and overall composition are pre-established.
Included modifications typically consist of character colors, markings, accessories, and advertised customization options.
Additional modifications beyond the advertised scope may require a custom commission quote.
YCH commissions follow the same payment, approval, and review policies as standard commissions.
Unless otherwise stated, the artist retains the right to reuse YCH templates for future commissions.

artistRights: The artist retains all rights to the original artwork unless otherwise agreed upon in writing.
Original project files are not included with commissions.
Examples include .CLIP, .PSD, and other source files.
watermarks: Watermarks, signatures, and copyright notices may not be removed without written permission.
finalDeliverables: Commissioned artwork is delivered as finished export files only unless otherwise agreed upon.

generalInformation: For detailed information regarding revisions, usage rights, refunds, and other policies, please review the full Terms of Service.
The artist reserves the right to decline any commission request for any reason.
Thank you for supporting my work!
